hooks.statusMessage: Pulling latest chatbot changes from GitHub…

hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && { if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then git add -A && git commit -q -m "Auto-sync from $(hostname -s): $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')"; fi; git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null; git push --quiet 2>/dev/null; } || true
